description: This file defines a Spring configuration class that sets up a batch job for retrieving delivery reports from an SMS gateway. It includes bean definitions for a tasklet, a step, and a job, utilizing Spring Batch components and dependencies related to SMS message processing.

classes.name: GetDeliveryReportsFromSmsGatewayConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that registers beans for a batch job to fetch SMS delivery reports from a gateway, including the necessary steps and tasklet.

methods.name: getDeliveryReportsFromSmsGatewayStep
methods.description: Defines the batch step that executes the tasklet for fetching delivery reports, utilizing the job repository and transaction manager.

methods.name: getDeliveryReportsFromSmsGatewayJob
methods.description: Defines the batch job that orchestrates the step and includes an incrementer for job runs.

methods.name: getDeliveryReportsFromSmsGatewayTasklet
methods.description: Creates the tasklet responsible for the actual fetching of delivery reports from the SMS gateway.
